Welcome! I’m so glad you’re here. Imagine tracing the footsteps of our ancestors, from their mysterious cave paintings to the breathtaking heights of ancient civilizations. Together, we’re about to set off on a journey that asks one of the most fascinating questions of all time—what truly makes us human?
In The Everlasting Man, G.K. Chesterton invites us to look beyond the idea that we’re just another species shaped by chance. Instead, he sparks curiosity about the spark of creativity and spirituality that we all share—those unique qualities that have always set people apart. As we move through the story of civilization, watch as the figure of Christ appears—not as just another moment in history, but as a turning point that changes everything. Chesterton’s blend of myth, philosophy, and faith guides us to see our familiar world with fresh eyes, and encourages us to question what we think we know about purpose, meaning, and the direction of history itself.
So, if you’re ready to explore the mysteries of human consciousness, the wonders of culture, and the transformative power of faith, you’re in the right place. Let’s discover together the extraordinary story that Chesterton has to share—and maybe, just maybe, see ourselves and our world a little differently by the end.
